main.description: Self-signed P-256 ECDSA endpoint certificate for AT-SMS secure messaging. One record per device, keyed by certificate serial number.

certificate.description: The X.509 certificate in PEM format (P-256 ECDSA, self-signed)

serialNumber.description: Certificate serial number (hexadecimal). Also used as the record key (rkey).

validUntil.description: Expiration date of the certificate (ISO 8601 format)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this record was created (ISO 8601 format)
